name: NeuTex
definition: A neural scene representation that explicitly disentangles scene geometry from appearance. Geometry is represented as a continuous 3D volume, while appearance is represented as a continuous 2D texture map in an automatically discovered UV space.
summary: NeuTex is a neural scene representation that disentangles geometry and appearance using separate MLPs for 3D volume density and 2D texture mapping, enabling texture editing unlike standard NeRF.
